test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8525c0c0b9835e01c5f080dbfad8df27c43684b0335d20e3d8a9462d7f0072ff.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Position of % is the same in middle.

**From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:**

Diagonal symbols are interchanging their position with each other.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

All corner symbols are shifting their position in anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13c77f76db99d44874c6cc966f1798dbee9f1359e88b78435694a92967894b29.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
